scripts.dev: npm run build -w @calisthenics/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @calisthenics/shared" "npm run dev -w @calisthenics/server" "npm run dev -w @calisthenics/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @calisthenics/shared && npm run build -w @calisthenics/server && npm run build -w @calisthenics/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @calisthenics/shared && npm run typecheck -w @calisthenics/server && npm run typecheck -w @calisthenics/client
